test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight students were sitting on two benches, L, M, N, O on the front bench and P, Q, R, S on the next one, but not in the same sequence. Q was sitting exactly behind M, who was sitting to the extreme right. O & P and L & S were sitting adjacent to each other in diagonally cross positions, S being on the extreme left. What was the sitting position of N?
solution:
The logic follows here is :-

Q was sitting exactly behind M, who was sitting to the extreme right.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb4d71b5e7da14239c1fde5d0b9f9704640e7a5848a51c850f0550dd26b45309.png] 

S being on the extreme left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee7d789a52ed6f0ced31e2dff784e3e0051f4ef8f0b18080e2b272564d8f8092.png] 

 

O & P and L & S were sitting adjacent to each other in diagonally cross positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d334c71f95eefdafaa8b3e92a46c9b40bf7e45e76130b203f8b1f2930f7786b.png] 

Eight students were sitting on two benches, L, M, N, O on the front bench and P, Q, R, S on the next one, but not in the same sequence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1109ba54b7a6bbc16826590dd556b3bc627282685824c85f2a9ffabf46b3beed.png] 

Thus, Exactly in front of R is sitting position of N.

Hence, the correct answer is "Exactly in front of R".
